scripts.browsers:install: npx playwright install firefox webkit && npx playwright install chrome
scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings src/ tests/ scripts/ demo/
scripts.lint:biome: biome check src/ tests/ scripts/ demo/
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:ui && npm run test:e2e:cross-browser
scripts.debug:inspect: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:contracts && tsx scripts/validation/debug-inspect.ts
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run demo:build && npm run demo:verify && npm run notices:verify && npm run docs:links && npm run lint && npm test && npm run conditions:validate && npm run composer:validate && npm run evidence:verify && npm run verify:contracts
scripts.check: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:preview && npm run runtime:matrix:required
scripts.screenshots:readme: npm run screenshots:capture && npm run screenshots:convert
scripts.release:alpha:local: npm run audit:dependencies && npm run check
scripts.release:alpha:checklist: npm run clean:local && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild esbuild sharp && npm run browsers:install && npm run release:alpha:local && npm run screenshots:readme && npm run screenshots:verify
